Final edit prompt:

Edit the provided elabmate logo into an ICON ONLY. Keep the friendly rounded open laboratory notebook shape: this is the central idea the user likes, a physics experiment notebook or 'cahier de manip'. REMOVE THE ENTIRE WORDMARK and all text beside the book; the result must contain zero letters, zero words and no caption. Recompose tightly as one balanced square icon with modest transparent padding around the book. Keep the dark scientific blue outline and restrained yellow/teal accents. Inside the notebook, REMOVE THE CHEMISTRY FLASK completely, including its neck, vessel, liquid and bubbles. Replace it with a simple elegant physics/optics motif: a small stylized atom on the right page, formed by two or three clean elliptical orbital strokes and a central nucleus, with a straight golden-yellow laser beam travelling from the left page to the atom. One or two subtle measurement/page lines on the left may balance the atom, but keep plenty of negative space and a strong small-size silhouette. Flat vector-like edges, consistent rounded strokes, no chemical glassware, no hexagon, no copied partner logos, no gradients, no glow, no 3D, no shadows, no mockup. One original independent square icon, genuinely transparent background with alpha.
